commits: 7f3f57d cleanup(cells-caps): step 1 — docs, shared group_sizing, folded MIM/MOM per-cell tail, even_up/grow_to_area helpers
dbc1a4a cleanup(cells-caps): step 2 — corner-case tests for capacitor, cap_array and post_cell
cleanup(cells-caps): step 3 — overflow-free unit sum, legal minimum unit and finger pitch, device spacing floor, saturating grow_to_area, true ceiling in on_grid_up
flaggedFixed: capacitor::enumerate summed dev_nf in u16: members past 65535 units panicked (debug) / wrapped (release); now u32, columns capped at u16::MAX, built lazily and cut at MAX_VARIANTS
capacitor comb divided by a zero finger pitch on a deck with no MOM keys and no met1/met2 width/space; finger width and space now floor at one grid step

capacitor with a zero/tiny unit side (no unitization, no cap_unit_side) drew sub-min-width metal and a comb electrode with negative width outside the plate; unit sides now floor at 2*finger_w + 2*finger_space

capacitor tiles abutted when the deck states no device_gap, shorting neighbouring devices' electrodes (sandwich strap rail touched the next BOT plate); the tile gap now floors at the worst metal spacing
cap_array grow_to_area (formerly the inline `tall`/island area growth) overflowed i32 when the area could not be met by any i32 height; now saturating
post_cell::on_grid_up truncated toward zero for negative values (not a ceiling); now div_euclid
flaggedOpen: cap_array::CapArray::metrics on a general (non-binary) set: the GND dummy slot has zero units, so dac::msys divides by a zero count (NaN/inf) and the bit-weighted route_spread is meaningless; only binary banks are ranked today, documented as such
post_cell::guard_rings shrinks a merged cluster's hull by the representative (widest) requirement's halo; a member whose own halo is smaller may see the band drawn inside its reservation
risks: No build was run: every change was type-checked by reading only; integration compile/test must confirm (notably the flat_map in capacitor::enumerate and `move` filter closures in post_cell tests)

Capacitor unit floor (2*finger_w + 2*finger_space) and tile gap floor (max(device_gap, m_space)) change geometry only on decks below those values; sky130/ihp/gf180 units and device_gap already exceed them
New Flat-deck tests in cap_array (largest 8-bit bank assignment, zero-gradient metrics) depend on analog::matching pattern/dac behaviour not exercised before at n = 8
No SIMD or branchless rewrites: these are per-cell geometry generators and O(n^2) post-placement passes over few cells, not hot numeric loops
